title: Account Access Recovery
content: For locked-out or compromised accounts, the agent must verify identity using at least two of: the account email, a recent invoice ID, or the billing contact name. Once verified, trigger a password-reset flow or a security review of active sessions. Do not disclose whether an account exists to unverified callers. Reset links expire after 2 hours. If MFA enrollment or suspicious activity is reported, flag the account for the security team within one business hour.
